purpose: Agent-readable artifact and capability contract for the R3.0-008B staged modeling decisions (segment 1, mechanical increment): the analyzed_not_materialized analysis conclusions, the stage 3 minimal slot prerequisite, the materialization unlock, coordinator approvals, the materialization ledger, the joint acceptance checklist, and the Runner-private staged Modeling Batch submission capability. Mechanical only; business semantics are owned by the modeling Agents and confirmed by the Coordinator.

artifact_locations.note: These are run-workspace process artifacts, not platform storage. Directories are prepared (mkdir only) at run prepare time; files are created only by their unique writer. A missing file IS the gate semantics. A symlinked, non-JSON, or escaping path is rejected without touching anything outside the run directory.

directory_writers.read_visibility: All three roles see the value-semantics/ tree read-only in their sandbox; only the listed unique writer receives a writable bind. submission-receipts/ and submission-intents/ are never sandbox-bound.

order: 3 platform-neutral base graph candidate (minimal slot, deferred_contract R3.0-009)
5 base business semantics modeling + value analysis (analyzed_not_materialized)
6 database mapping and value semantics materialization (unlock + staged submission)
rules: Staged artifact feedback names a recoverable correction and does not send a separate success/reopen acknowledgement. After fixing the named artifact, the next native call rechecks current admission; preserve exact review/apply approvals and handle any new typed rejection instead of waiting for an extra message.

A required protected body outside Protocol's scoped credential can be supplied as Host-authorized production readback using actual current governed responses, not counts or write receipts. Preserve that credential's denied view, do not change grants/keys to finish production, and keep final independent readback separate rather than waiting for it to repair production.

the stage 3 slot is a prerequisite of the R3.0-002 topology gate: while the slot is missing or invalid the topology check is skipped without closing or latching the shared platform gate; stage3_* reason codes surface only through feedback and evidence streams

value semantics materialization (stage 6) requires a valid materialize-mode unlock and confirmed conclusions; while locked, every staged submission carrying create_enum_meaning, update_enum_meaning, or L3 create_entity commands is rejected with staged_value_materialization_locked
the Coordinator may not report terminal completed while the joint acceptance checklist is missing or structurally invalid; blocked reports always pass

legal_transitions: conflict -> analyzed (via revision increment with archived predecessor)
rules: mapped_property is an absolute IRI; proposed_level is one of L1, L2, L3; blocking_unknowns is an optional list

candidate_value and confirmed_enum_value each hold the conclusion's enum code set: either one non-empty string, or a non-empty list of non-empty strings when the conclusion resolves several codes (one create_enum_meaning command is submitted per code); an empty value, empty list, or a list holding empty or non-string items is invalid (conclusions_schema_mismatch for candidate_value, conclusions_invalid_status_fields for a confirmed/materialized confirmed_enum_value)
status analyzed forbids confirmed_enum_value, confirmed_by, and conflict_note
status confirmed and materialized require confirmed_enum_value and confirmed_by and forbid conflict_note
status conflict requires conflict_note and forbids confirmed_by; confirmed_enum_value may record the disputed candidate

revision is a positive integer; when an archive exists for the conclusion_id the current revision must be exactly max(archived)+1 and the (previous_status, current_status) pair must be a legal transition; without an archive the revision must be 1
the immutable predecessor is archived first at conclusions-archive/<conclusion_id>.r<revision>.json; every other transition is illegal
status materialized additionally requires a ledger entry naming the conclusion_id
the modeling Agent never self-confirms from database samples: confirmation is recorded by the Coordinator through approvals after business confirmation
approved_by is non-empty (the minimal approval record; the Coordinator also anchors it in approvals with kind stage3_slot and target_id equal to scenario_id)
deferred_contract is exactly R3.0-009 (explicit backfill point for the full stage 3 contract)
candidate_artifacts is a non-empty list of run-workspace-relative paths without escape; each must exist as a regular file
slot_note is optional free text

mode materialize requires a non-empty mapping_sources list of {source_type, reference} and a confirmed_codes list whose entries carry conclusion_id, mapped_property, confirmed_enum_value, and confirmed_level exactly matching the referenced confirmed conclusion
mode skip requires skip_reason exactly no_schema_no_interface, no mapping_sources, no confirmed_codes, and no conclusion in confirmed or materialized status
a dangling confirmed_codes reference is rejected with unlock_dangling_conclusion; any field drift against the confirmed conclusion is rejected with unlock_code_mismatch
an absent unlock file means stage 6 stays locked (staged_value_materialization_locked)

kind conclusion_confirmation: target_id is the conclusion_id, revision equals the current conclusion revision, and confirmed_enum_value equals the conclusion's confirmed_enum_value in the same form (one non-empty string, or a non-empty list of non-empty strings mirroring the conclusion's code set); every confirmed or materialized conclusion must be anchored by such an entry (conclusions_approval_missing otherwise)
kind stage3_slot: target_id is the slot's scenario_id and approved_by matches the slot's approved_by; confirmed_enum_value must be absent (stage3_approval_record_missing otherwise)
revision is required on every entry, including kind stage3_slot, and is a positive integer >= 1; null and boolean values are invalid (approvals_schema_mismatch otherwise)
the approvals artifact is the authoritative approval record; approval authority is anchored mechanically by the coordinator-exclusive writable directory bind

each entry must close against an authoritative Runner receipt: the receipt_ordinal names an existing receipt whose batch_id matches, whose mode is apply_atomic, and whose commands list contains command_digest
semantic_value_iri is optional; when present it must be non-empty
a conclusions entry with status materialized requires a ledger entry naming it

the ledger records materialized value conclusions, not every ordinary command or plan; ordinary commands without a materialized value conclusion require no new entries, and entries=[] is valid when none has been materialized; their actual Batch/Attempt and Runner receipt still establish execution, and no conclusion_id may be invented merely to make the ledger nonempty

command_digest is canonical_command_digest of the complete actual submitted Batch item: SHA-256 of its UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True and separators=(comma,colon), prefixed sha256:; retain every item field actually submitted, not only command_kind/payload and not the entire Batch or projection

close each materialized value conclusion immediately after its clean applied Attempt is verified; when the role cannot read Runner-private receipts, obtain Host-bound receipt guidance, never guess command digests or replay an applied plan to obtain them
exactly the seven fixed items, each once, each with item_id, verdict, evidence_ref, and checked_by
the Coordinator's terminal completed report is refused while the checklist is missing or structurally invalid; blocked reports always pass
R3.0-008A evidence does not substitute for the r30008a_representative_question_recheck item and vice versa
the envelope mirrors the platform submit_modeling_batch signature verbatim; only the batch object is forwarded to the platform, byte-for-byte
mode apply_atomic additionally requires a non-empty lease_token
items is a non-empty list of {command_kind, payload}; payload is an object
every create_enum_meaning and update_enum_meaning command must carry at least one trace naming a known conclusion (staged_missing_trace / staged_trace_mismatch otherwise)
the traced conclusion must be in confirmed status (staged_conclusion_not_confirmed, staged_conclusion_conflict, staged_conclusion_already_materialized otherwise)

create_enum_meaning payload must carry property_iri equal to the conclusion's mapped_property and enum_value equal to one code of the conclusion's confirmed_enum_value; when the conclusion carries a list of codes, each code is materialized by its own create_enum_meaning command
update_enum_meaning traces must carry mapped_property equal to the conclusion's mapped_property; update_enum_meaning payload must not carry property_iri

an update_enum_meaning without enum_value must name its enum target (enum_meaning_id or enum_meaning_iri) already covered by an authoritative receipt traced to the same conclusion (staged_unknown_enum_target otherwise)
every L3 create_entity command must be listed (it is a materialization command: the unlock precondition applies)

each node must reference the create_entity payload identity and carry a semantic_value_iri matching an enum command's semantic_value in the same batch; future receipt_ref is an identity-binding locator, never a replacement for this IRI

an L3 node is backed by a same-batch enum command value_trace naming a confirmed conclusion whose effective level (confirmed_level or proposed_level) is L3 (staged_l3_unapproved otherwise); the materialize unlock and existing approval gates still apply

For the first combined create_entity plus create_enum_meaning stage, Host may supply the authoritative intended resource_iri from actual backend outputs_for, deployed Settings and the exact nonempty explicit entity_id and planned command context. Use it in l3_nodes.semantic_value_iri and the matching enum payload.semantic_value; the node's unified identity_binding stays future receipt_ref with resource_iri/evidence_ref null. This does not assert resource existence or waive confirmation.

Compare the actual dry_run/apply resource_outputs to Host's intended resource_id/resource_iri and stop affected writes/dependencies if they drift. Later dependent stages use real receipt/read identities; neither Modeling nor Protocol guesses namespace IRIs.

execution_rules: mechanical checks run in a fixed order: gate state, envelope schema, unlock precondition, create_enum_meaning matching, update_enum_meaning matching, L3 nodes, durable intent write, host-side forward, unknown adjudication, receipt
a durable submission intent is written BEFORE the host-side forward; the Runner-supplied idempotency_key and client_batch_id are reused verbatim on retries
the host-side forward is a Runner-injected write path; value_traces and l3_nodes never leave the Runner

an indeterminate forward result marks the intent unknown, rejects every new submission with staged_unreconciled_batch, and fires the kill-switch (manual adjudication via the three deterministic branches: claim the platform-listing hit, retry with the same key, or suspend)

an authoritative receipt is written only after a definite result that actually returned a real platform Batch; the intent transitions submitted -> receipted; a typed pre-write refusal instead closes the intent as rejected with no receipt and the accurate error evidence preserved, and unknown/unparseable forward results still close the write gate; a receipted idempotency key is rejected with staged_conclusion_already_materialized
every rejection is a typed reason code returned as structured error content; each code names the artifact to repair and the run continues

rules: receipts are the authoritative application record; submitted_via is always protocol_staged_submit_modeling_batch

the Runner stamps an additive enum_target field on receipt value_traces entries whose traced command is an enum command, so later update_enum_meaning without enum_value can close its target against receipts

triggers: a receipted intent with no receipt file
a platform batch listing entry with no Runner intent (bypassed direct submission)
a receipted intent with no platform batch (fake receipt)
kill_switch.behavior: The shared platform MCP gate closes and stays closed until a human adjudicates the durable intents with the deterministic branches; every staged submission is rejected meanwhile. This is the only hard stop; every other failure is typed, repairable feedback and the run continues.

execution.non_staged_conservation: Tasks without the staged parameter keep byte-identical capability operation sets, sandbox binds, and validation behavior.
